items.title: Monday.com is the latest tech company to blame AI for layoffs — here are 20 others
items.summary: Monday.com joins a growing list of over 20 tech companies that have cited AI as a reason for recent layoffs, highlighting a significant industry trend.

items.title: One fallen power line exposed a growing AI data center problem. Here’s how to fix it.
items.summary: A single power line failure has brought to light the increasing vulnerability and infrastructure challenges faced by rapidly expanding AI data centers, prompting calls for urgent solutions.

items.title: Librarians are hosting viral ‘Avoiding AI’ workshops for people who are fed up with Big Tech
items.summary: Librarians are gaining traction with popular workshops designed to help individuals navigate and minimize their interaction with AI technologies, reflecting growing public sentiment against Big Tech.

items.title: NVIDIA-labs OO Agents: Native Python Object-Oriented Agents
items.summary: NVIDIA-labs introduces a new framework for native Python object-oriented agents, offering a structured approach for developing complex AI systems.

items.title: K12-KGraph: A Curriculum-Aligned Knowledge Graph for Benchmarking and Training Educational LLMs
items.summary: Researchers introduce K12-KGraph, a curriculum-aligned knowledge graph designed to benchmark and enhance the training of large language models specifically for educational applications.

items.title: Create, edit and star in videos with two Google Vids updates
items.summary: Google Vids receives two new updates, enabling users to create, edit, and feature themselves in videos more easily, leveraging AI for enhanced content creation.

items.title: NTT DATA Group cuts incident analysis to 30 minutes with Codex
items.summary: NTT DATA Group has significantly reduced incident analysis time to just 30 minutes by integrating OpenAI's Codex, demonstrating the practical impact of AI in IT operations.

items.title: SANA-Video 2.0: Hybrid Linear Attention with Attention Residuals for Efficient Video Generation
items.summary: SANA-Video 2.0 introduces a novel hybrid linear attention mechanism with attention residuals, significantly improving the efficiency of video generation models.

items.title: Tencent WorkBuddy Bench: A Multi-Domain Coding-Agent Benchmark with Contamination-Resistant Task Construction
items.summary: Tencent introduces WorkBuddy Bench, a new multi-domain benchmark for coding agents featuring contamination-resistant task construction to accurately evaluate their performance.

items.title: LLMs Get Lost in Evolving User Intent
items.summary: New research indicates that Large Language Models struggle to maintain coherence and effectiveness when user intent evolves during a conversation, highlighting a key challenge in conversational AI.

items.title: Self-Supervised Learning of Structured Dynamics from Videos
items.summary: A new paper explores self-supervised learning methods to extract structured dynamics directly from video data, advancing the field of AI understanding complex temporal relationships.

items.title: Streaming Multi-Agent Autoregressive Diffusion Model with World State Registers
items.summary: Researchers propose a streaming multi-agent autoregressive diffusion model that utilizes world state registers to enhance the generation of complex, dynamic environments.

items.title: We instrumented an AI agent swarm with SigNoz, and its own telemetry told us we were wrong about almost everything
items.summary: Instrumenting an AI agent swarm with SigNoz revealed unexpected insights from its telemetry, challenging initial assumptions about its behavior and performance.

items.title: What is Good? Extracting and Testing Implicit Theories of Literary Quality from LLM Reasoning Traces
items.summary: This research investigates how to extract and test implicit theories of literary quality by analyzing the reasoning traces of Large Language Models.

items.title: Knowledge Injection Exists in MoE? Exploring Expert-Aware Contrast Decoding in MoE for Mitigating LLMs'Hallucinations
items.summary: A new study explores the phenomenon of knowledge injection in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models and proposes an expert-aware contrast decoding method to reduce hallucinations in LLMs.
